subject: POC: interoperability, streaming & toolchain success criteria
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC: interoperability, streaming & toolchain success criteria

Hi Liam — great to meet virtually earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a shared checklist for the trial: 

Call recap: short
- Goal: Run a 4-week POC to validate inference latency/throughput and streaming integration for Atlas’ live annotation pipeline.
- Primary success metric: 95th percentile end-to-end latency < 600ms for 256-token requests at sustained 50 rps.
- Secondary metrics: token cost per 1k, model output quality on the provided prompt set (A/B vs internal baseline), and stable KV cache hit-rate > 70%.

Proposed evaluation plan (high level):
1) Week 0: Provision sandbox instance (Redwood hosted dedicated trial) + API keys.
2) Week 1: SDK integration (streaming + tool calling demo) + smoke tests.
3) Week 2: Load tests, latency profiling, and telemetry wiring.
4) Week 3: Quality validation, regression checks on prompt set, and product demos for your Eng + ML teams.
5) Week 4: Acceptance sign-off or list of remaining action items.

Integration/implementation asks and owners (first pass):
- SDK integration (websocket streaming sample + reconnect handling): Marissa Cole (internal) — deliver sample client and README by 2028-03-24.
- API routing and tool-calling hooks: Ben Carter (internal) — provide API route map and example tool invocation patterns by 2028-03-25.
- Telemetry & tracing: Vanessa Ortiz (me) — share telemetry template and required spans/events for your SRE by 2028-03-24.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (workbook with acceptance criteria), integration-telemetry-template.md (telemetry fields we expect).

Can you confirm: 1) the success metric above aligns with your expectations, 2) if procurement timeline (we heard 3–4 weeks) is accurate, and 3) any additional security/compliance docs we should surface this week?

If that looks good we’ll schedule a 30-min kick-off for Monday to hand off the SDK sample and start provisioning.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com
---
Attachment: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: integration-telemetry-template.md (text/markdown)

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: interoperability, streaming & toolchain success criteria

Thanks Vanessa — that summary is super helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success metrics: the latency target looks reasonable. Can we also add a recovery objective for intermittent reconnects (client reconnect < 2s and no message duplication)?
2) SDK: we prefer a Node + Python streaming sample (we'll have teams using both). Do you provide a gRPC stream option or just websocket/HTTP streaming?
3) Telemetry: legal asked for a simple dataflow diagram showing what data leaves our VPC during the trial (could be synthetic). Can you produce a one-page diagram?
4) Procurement: procurement@atlasanalytics.com is looped in — they asked if we can get an SOW + trial order form this week so finance can start approval.

Next steps for us: I’ll confirm our internal evaluators (ML lead and SRE) and send over the prompt set by Friday. We should be able to kick off the sandbox next week if provisioning is quick.

—Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform Engineering, Atlas Analytics
liam.oneill@atlasanalytics.com
---
Note: procurement@atlasanalytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@atlasanalytics.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: interoperability, streaming & toolchain success criteria

Hi Liam — thanks, we can cover all of that. Quick updates from the engineering side: 

- SDKs: we’ll provide both Node and Python streaming clients. They support websocket and gRPC streaming. I’ll attach a minimal sample that shows reconnect, idempotency tokens, and resume via KV-cache continuation.
- Recovery objective: we’ll add a client reconnect handling section to the sample and include a short chaos test script to validate < 2s reconnect behavior.
- Dataflow diagram: creating a 1-page diagram now — will drop into the Drive folder linked below.
- SOW/Trial order: Ben, can you please prepare the standard 4-week POC SOW + order form? We can conditionally include the dedicated sandbox and support hours.

Attachment: streaming-sample.tar.gz (contains node/example.js, python/example.py, README.md)

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
---
Attachment: streaming-sample.tar.gz (application/gzip)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@atlasanalytics.com>, procurement@atlasanalytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: interoperability, streaming & toolchain success criteria

Thanks all — finalizing owners and dates below so we can move fast. I’ll also schedule the 30-min kick-off for Monday 2028-03-27 10:00 PT (tbd).

Committed owners and deliverables:
- Sandbox provisioning (Redwood hosted): Ben Carter — provisioned credentials and network IP allowlist by 2028-03-25 EOD.
- SDK samples (Node + Python, websocket + gRPC) + reconnect/chaos script: Marissa Cole — sample repo and README by 2028-03-24 EOD.
- Telemetry template + 1-page dataflow diagram: Vanessa Ortiz — shared Drive link and telemetry checklist by 2028-03-24 EOD.
- SOW + order form for procurement: Ben Carter — draft to procurement@atlasanalytics.com by 2028-03-23 EOD.
- Kick-off and handoff: All — 2028-03-27 10:00 PT.

Acceptance criteria (concrete):
- E2E: 95th percentile latency < 600ms at 50 rps for 256-token payloads.
- Recovery: client reconnect < 2s, no duplicated events in replay window.
- Quality: model output passes the provided prompt set with >= 90% agreement against your baseline on the scoring rubric (we’ll formalize the rubric).
- Observability: traces and metrics visible in your telemetry with the specified spans/events.

Procurement: attaching the SOW draft and order form now (Ben, thanks). If procurement can review today we’ll push provisioning immediately.

Links: HubSpot deal (above), Drive folder with diagram and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-atlas-poc

Let me know if I missed anything. Excited to get started.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: integration-telemetry-template.md, redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx
